MedicalJobsAustralia.com     WHD2 Services Assistant - Cummins Maternity Leave contract



 Apply now
 Job no: 944946

 Work type: Part time

 Location: Eyre and Western

 Categories: Catering and Hospitality, Community and Social Services, Child, Aged and Disability Care, Support Services





 

Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, Cummins 

Salary: WHD2 $1,204.70 - $1,226.60 per week (Pro-rata)+ 12% Superannuation + Leave Loading and Salary Sacrifice Benefits

Temporary Part-time position working 18 hours per week (up to 1 August 2028)

Overview

At Cummins Multi-Purpose Service, every shift leaves a mark - on a meal served with care, a clean room, a resident who feels seen. This part-time maternity leave contract (concluding 1 August 2028) offers flexible hours that can be negotiated to suit school commitments, making it a genuine opportunity for someone looking to contribute meaningfully to regional healthcare without compromising family life.

What the Role Involves

As a WHD2 Services Assistant within the Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, you'll move across a range of hands-on tasks that keep Cummins MPS running smoothly for the community it serves.

Preparing, delivering, and serving nutritious meals in line with individual dietary and care requirements

Maintaining cleanliness across the facility through housekeeping and laundry duties

Providing respectful, attentive service to clients, residents, and staff throughout each shift

Upholding food safety, infection control, and safe work practices at all times

What You'll Bring

A flexible, willing approach to varied tasks across different service areas

Strong communication skills and the ability to work respectfully with people from diverse backgrounds

Practical knowledge of food safety, housekeeping, and laundry processes

An understanding of confidentiality and the ability to meet deadlines in a care environment

Reliability and attention to detail that keeps spaces safe and welcoming

Experience in a healthcare or aged care setting, consistent with SA Health's commitment to safe, person-centred service delivery

Life at Cummins MPS

SA Health is built on the values of respect, integrity, and care - and at Cummins MPS, those values show up in the everyday. You'll be part of a close-knit team where your contribution is visible and genuinely matters to the people relying on local services in this regional community. As a public sector employee, you'll have access to salary packaging options, career development pathways, and the stability of working within South Australia's public health system. Regional health work offers something many roles simply cannot replicate: a direct, meaningful connection to the place and people you serve.

How to Apply

This is a part-time position based at Cummins MPS, Eyre and Far North Local Health Network, offered as a maternity leave contract through to 1 August 2028. Hours can be negotiated to suit school schedules. Submit your application through the SA Health careers portal, and if you'd like a conversation about the role before applying, contact the hiring manager listed in the job details.

About Us

With its ancient outback landscapes, boutique vineyards, oyster farms and Australia's best-kept-secret surf coast, Eyre and Far North will inspire and energise you.

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN) is responsible for the planning and delivery of hospital and health services over 337,626 square kilometres, taking in the Eyre Peninsula, western part of South Australia and north to Coober Pedy. We are one of the largest LHNs by area in Australia and communities include Ceduna, Cleve, Coober Pedy, Cowell, Cummins, Elliston, Kimba, Oodnadatta, Port Lincoln, Streaky Bay, Tumby Bay and Wudinna.

Services include acute care, medical, accident and emergency, surgery, birthing and midwifery, specialist consultancy, renal dialysis, chemotherapy, transfusions, rehabilitation, residential and community aged care, respite care, transitional care packages, Aboriginal health, mental health, allied health, community health, community nursing, palliative care, community home support packages and home modifications.

Click here to learn more about living and working in Eyre and Far North Local Health Network.

Why Join Us

Make a real difference and feel like an important part of the community. Being part of Eyre & Far North means you will be supported both personally and professionally, can take advantage of education and training opportunities, will have access to flexible working hours and be part of an inter-professional approach to holistic health care.

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT year Click here more information

Wellbeing and counselling support: support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program

Relocation support: relocation reimbursement of up to $15,000 may be available to people relocating for this opportunity. More information available from SA Health Careers - Relocation support.

Employee recognition: supportive and collaborative work environment where your contributions are valued and recognised.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

SA Health is committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees. We strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, members of the LGBTIQA+SB community and people who live with disability and-or neurodivergence.

We are committed to making workplace adjustments to provide a positive and supportive work environment. You are encouraged to let us know if have any support or access requirements during the recruitment process and beyond to ensure you can perform at your best.

Applicant Information

The South Australian public sector promotes diversity and flexible ways of working part-time. Applicants are encouraged to discuss the flexible working arrangements for this role.

Appointment will be subject to a satisfactory Criminal History Check and appropriate immunisation requirements.

Check(s)

National Police Certificate (NPC) for employment involving unsupervised contact with vulnerable groups required for this position (E.g. aged care employment or work involving vulnerable clients)

Immunisation Risk for this position is - Category A (direct contact with blood or body substances)

SA Health Services are required to implement the Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy in the workplace.

For more information about the role please refer to the role description provided below. Job Ref: 944946

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Service Registrar - General Surgery (2027 Intake) (Multiple Positions)





Job no: 943133

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Northern

Categories: Medical




 

Northern Adelaide Local Health Network - Division of Surgical Specialties and Anaesthetics - Various Locations

Total Indicative Remuneration: $118,024 - $190,058 p.a. - MDP2 

Temporary Full-Time, up to 30 January 2028 (Multiple Positions)

About the Role: 

An exciting opportunity is presented to work within the Northern Adelaide Local Health Network as a Medical Practitioner - General Surgery within the Division of Surgical Specialties and Anaesthetics.

The NALHN General Surgery Service Registrars will be placed across 4 units - ASU, Modbury General Surgery, Port Pirie Regional Health Service and Alice Springs Hospital.

The registrars will be offered a combination of time on 2 of these units throughout the year offering a broad exposure to emergency and elective general surgery - preferences will be asked then allocated based on suitability

This role has been designed to prepare suitable candidates for application to general surgery training through exposure to a high volume of common general surgery presentations and operations

Selected candidates will be expected to participate in research and quality improvement whilst employed in the role as well as undertaking other courses and appropriate activities to further their surgical career goals. Opportunities for teaching opportunities, research publications and higher degrees can be discussed and will be supported.

Whilst on the General Surgery unit the registrar will be responsible for supporting their senior registrar in the day to day management of both elective and emergency inpatients, interacting with allied health, supervising junior doctors, assisting in theatres and operating under direct supervision

Whilst on ASU the registrar is responsible, under the supervision of the rostered general surgical registrar, fellow and consultant for the assessment and initial management of acute surgical patients referred by the emergency department or general practitioners

On ASU registrars work a week on-off roster to provide 7 day a week continuous cover to ED and to enable the 4 hour rule of admission to function.

When visiting Port Pirie Regional Health Service you will be responsible for low acuity day surgery, outpatients, and limited scope emergency work.

Candidates rotating to Alice Springs Hospital, as a General Surgery registrar, will contribute to the delivery of elective and emergency general surgery under supervision by senior registrars and consultants, whilst experiencing the unique opportunities that Alice Springs Hospital has to offer.

The peri-operative work up, booking of cases and timely communication to senior staff is a key responsibility in this role

Monthly dedicated ASU Registrar teaching is offered by fellows and consultants.

To be eligible for this position, you must [minimum qualification requirements from Role Description]

As per the SA Health Salaried Medical Officers Enterprise Agreement 2025, the total term of employment with SA Health will be 3 years. Rotations following the initial 12 month allocation as Medical Practitioner will be determined in line with your training and SA Health's requirements. This may include transfer to other SA Health locations to perform work appropriate to classification, skills and capabilities.

To be eligible for this position, you must hold a Bachelor of Medicine; Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) or equivalent and Registrable with the Medical Board of Australia as a Medical Practitioner with General Registration
